title: DotPlotParams
description: Parameters governing the dot-plot doctrine's per-meeting anchoring bonus and spread-exposure cost.

anchoring_bonus.description: Credibility gained per FOMC meeting while the dot-plot doctrine is adopted.

exposure_per_pp.description: Credibility lost per percentage-point of preferred-rate spread when spread > spread_threshold.

dissent_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the exposure cost when at least one member dissents.

spread_threshold.description: Minimum spread (decimal, e.g. 0.005 = 50 bp) below which no exposure cost applies.
